5. From 1 and 3 and the rule “Cold, smart things are white”: Harry is white. (Cold ∧ Smart → White)  
6. From 4 and 5 and the rule “All white, green things are young”: Harry is young. (White ∧ Green → Young)  

Since we have derived that Harry is young, the statement “Harry is not young” does not follow.
